opening.argument: The speaker promotes StrongBlock nodes as a paid route to recurring returns, presenting a claimed passive income of $7,500 per month and an expected payback in roughly 100 days. Participation requires a contribution of 10 Strong, described as approximately $5,000, while the committed Strong is not returned: “you're giving those up you'll never get those back but you will be compensated for each node point one strong every single day.” The speaker directs viewers to create a Polygon node and approve spending from MetaMask, and the supplied frame shows the corresponding node-creation form and contribution terms. Although the speaker says the returns are never guaranteed and calls the content not financial advice, those disclaimers do not remove the paid-entry structure or the promoted recurring-return calculation. The available evidence shows promotion and instructions, not a completed transaction or realized return.
